name: A Dark Threat Looms
label: Quest
description: A desperate emergency mission given by Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII to prevent the destruction of the Stonewrought Dam. Dark Iron saboteurs have planted…
intro: A desperate emergency mission given by Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII to prevent the destruction of the Stonewrought Dam. Dark Iron saboteurs have planted an explosive Seaforium charge deep below the waterline, threatening to shatter one of the greatest engineering marvels of the dwarven kingdom.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Earlier today I spotted some Dark Iron Insurgents swimming toward the Dam with a large keg. No Mountaineers were on hand to stop them! I'm afraid they've planted the Seaforium at the base of the Dam and it could blow at any minute! Let me combine all these ingredients into the Disarming Mixture. There we go.
Now I need you to take this mixture and stir it into the keg before it's too late! Hurry!

clips.title: Progress
paras: The top of the keg slowly twists off.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The keg fizzles slightly as the Disarming Mixture settles in.
